name: Lavender
shortDescription: Purple flower spikes with a calming, sweet scent.
description: Lavender is a fragrant flowering herb with silvery-green foliage and purple blooms. Bees and other pollinators visit its flowers.
use: Garden fragrance, potpourri and pollinator-friendly borders.
growingTips: Plant in full sun and free-draining soil. Avoid rich, wet soil and prune lightly after flowering.
